records.message: the matrix matriz.fs is in neither the workspace root nor inputs/matrices/. Every post-only choice falls back to the run records, and the rotor tables, which take their geometry from the row's reference, are not written.

the run record carries no reduction windows, so no reduction of the plots table can say which steps it averaged; the record was written before the field existed or by hand. Rerun the row, and the record will carry the windows its row states.
records.remedy: restore the required data or correct the stated inputs and post again.
